title: Generate an internal @ln/arc-* lib
description: Scaffolds a buildable, non-publishable lib under libs/<scope>/<type>/<name> with repo conventions.

name.description: Lib name in kebab-case. Becomes the importPath @ln/arc-<name>.

scope.description: Sharing scope: shared (any bundle) or foodit (Foodit bundles).

type.description: Lib type, drives boundary tags and folder.
